docs.title: Architecture Decision Records (ADRs)
docs.text:
This index lists all decisions. New ADRs append at the end. Superseded ADRs keep their files but are annotated.

  • ADR-000 — Architecture Style (Accepted)
  • ADR-001 — IDs & Time (Accepted)
  • ADR-002 — FX Provider SPI (Accepted)
  • ADR-003 — Message Versioning (Accepted)
  • ADR-004 — Idempotency Strategy (Accepted)
  • ADR-005 — Bank Attribution & Multi-currency Balances (Accepted)

docs.title: Context
docs.text: We need an evolvable architecture supporting incomplete specs, event notifications, and strict NFRs (performance, security, observability).

docs.title: Decision
docs.text: Adopt a Hexagonal architecture within a Modular Monolith, with REST APIs (/v1) and event notifications via RabbitMQ. Use OpenAPI for contracts, Avro/JSON Schema for events. Observability via OpenTelemetry → Prometheus + Grafana.

docs.title: Consequences
docs.text:
• Clear separation of domain/application/infrastructure; adapters for DB, messaging, FX, Excel.
  • Easier local development and later extraction of services if needed.
  • Contract-first development with CDC feasible.

docs.title: Context
docs.text: Consistency across modules and FX calculations requires unambiguous IDs and timestamps.

docs.title: Decision
docs.text:
• Use UUID v4 as primary keys.
  • Store all timestamps as UTC (timestamptz).
  • APIs accept/return ISO-8601 in UTC.

docs.title: Consequences
docs.text:
• Safe merges across tenants and imports.
  • Deterministic historical FX conversion.

docs.title: Context
docs.text: The system must calculate historical conversions between USD, EUR, and COP at the transaction date, with the flexibility to change sources.

docs.title: Decision
docs.text:
• Define a pluggable SPI for historical FX (per day, per currency pair).
  • Implement a local cache keyed by (date, from, to).
  • Initial provider: stub for tests; real provider chosen via a follow-up spike.

docs.title: Consequences
docs.text:
• Swap FX providers without core changes.
  • Deterministic tests with stubbed rates.

docs.title: Context
docs.text: Events evolve; consumers need compatibility.

docs.title: Decision
docs.text:
• Topic naming includes version, e.g., transaction.imported.v1.
  • Additive changes only in-place; breaking changes → new topic .v2.
  • Maintain schema registry and CDC tests.

docs.title: Consequences
docs.text:
• Consumers can migrate at their own pace.
  • Clear upgrade path for breaking changes.

docs.title: Context
docs.text: Clients and ingestion may retry writes; we must prevent duplicates.

docs.title: Decision
docs.text:
• Require Idempotency-Key header on mutating HTTP requests.
  • Persist processed keys per route (route, key) with response hash.
  • Transactions ingestion idempotency by (tenant_id, source_id).

docs.title: Consequences
docs.text:
• Safe retries; observability of deduplicated requests.
  • Minimal storage overhead for keys table.

docs.title: Context
docs.text: We must identify the originating bank for each transaction and expose balances in account currency + EUR + COP using historical FX.

docs.title: Decision
docs.text:
• Introduce bank entity (tenant-scoped) and add bank_id FK to transaction.
  • Compute balances on read using historical FX at transaction date; cache daily rates.
  • Provide Balance API returning native + EUR + COP equivalents.

docs.title: Consequences
docs.text:
• One additional FK and supporting indexes: (tenant_id, bank_id, booking_date).
  • Slightly higher read cost; mitigated with FX/day cache and SQL view/projection.
  • Leaves room for future balance snapshots if necessary; API remains stable.

• Add bankId to Transaction schema (non-breaking, optional in request, present in response).
  • Add /v1/banks CRUD resources.

docs.title: Supported Versions
docs.text: Until 1.0.0, only the main branch receives fixes.

docs.title: Reporting a Vulnerability
docs.text: Please open a private security advisory or email the maintainers. Do not create public issues for vulnerabilities.

docs.title: Standards
docs.text:
• OWASP ASVS Level 3
  • Security headers (CSP, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy)
  • Least-privilege DB roles; secrets via environment/secret manager
  • SBOM + image scanning (e.g., Trivy)

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text:
• API P95 latency < 200 ms (reads)
  • Error rate < 0.1%
  • MTTR < 30 min

docs.title: Indicators (examples)
docs.text:
• http_server_request_duration_seconds → P95 (PromQL)
  • Error ratio of 5xx over total
  • DLQ depth for messaging

docs.title: Alert Hints
docs.text:
• P95 above threshold for 5 min
  • Error rate > 0.1% for 5 min
  • DLQ > 0

docs.title: 2025-09-29 — Bank attribution + multi-currency balances
docs.text:
Summary - Add bank identifier on every transaction (FR-10). - Maintain running balances in EUR and COP (FR-11).

Impacts - Contracts: +bankId in Transaction resource (backward-compatible). - Data: new bank table and bank_id FK in transaction. - Security/Privacy: no new PII; ensure bank names are tenant-scoped. - Operations: FX cache must cover USD/EUR/COP by date.

Actions - ADR-005 created to justify schema & projection approach. - Migrations added (V5__bank_and_tx_fk.sql). - OpenAPI updated: /v1/transactions includes bankId.
